description: Ministry of Fisheries - Amendment to the Culture of Coral Species on Artificial Substrate for Export Regulations
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Fisheries under the National Aquaculture Development Authority of Sri Lanka Act, No. 53 of 1998. It specifically amends existing regulations regarding coral culture for export, which falls under legal/regulatory matters (new laws, acts, regulations, and amendments). While it mentions a government minister, it does not focus on personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather on the regulatory framework itself.
